Name: Additional Tree Equipments (and tap giant crops)
Author: zombifier
Description:
Fruit trees are cool, but they're only useful one season out of four. And wild trees' tapper produce aren't that valuable outside of crafting (or at all in the case of sap). This mod allows them to be more productive year-round by adding extra machines that you can place on them.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975]Custom Tapper Framework[/url].

List of machines:

[list]
[*]Tree Bee House: A bee house that has been modified to be placeable on trees. Produces delicious honey every four days, except in winter. Unlocked at the same time as regular bee houses (Farming level 3)
[*]Bird House: Birds will periodically bring you random trinkets, forage, and even the occasional gemstones every day. Unlocked at Forage level 8.
[*]Mushroom Grower: Plant these spores on a tree to grow mushrooms. Works even faster than regular mushroom logs (especially on fruit trees), and is certified not harmful to the tree. Unlocked at the same time as regular mushroom logs (Foraging level 4)
[/list]
Suggestions for more buildings are greatly welcome.

Additionally, this mod allows regular tappers to be placed on fruit trees and giant crops. Tapped fruit trees produce sap (what did you expect?), while tapped giant crops will yield juice (or honey in case of modded giant flowers).


Mod integration:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿: Should work, but let me know if there are issues.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13052]Tap Giant Crops[/url]﻿: Likely will NOT work, since they both do the same thing. Make sure to remove that mod if you're using it.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22672]Junimatic[/url]﻿: Should also work.

[/list]
